title: Photograph the region capture overlay for its audit
goal: The audit for the new capture overlay has no picture in it, because the machine was locked when it was written and a locked screen cannot be photographed. Take the picture, so anyone reading the audit can see the dimmed screen and the drag box rather than take our word for it.
notes: Scripts/probe-app.sh --no-build, then: open -a "dist/Photonz Probe.app" --args --capture-diag. It writes /tmp/photonz-capture-diag.txt (dim latency, double-dim ratio) and /tmp/photonz-capture-diag-drag.png, then quits itself. The first line of the report says whether the screen was locked; if it was, the whole run is of the lock screen and must be thrown away. Downscale the PNG before committing it, the raw one is 10 MB. See docs/design/playtest-harness.md.
acceptance: The probe is run once on an unlocked screen and produces a real screen capture of the region capture overlay with a box being dragged
The picture shows the whole display dimmed, the box bright, the size pill, and nothing beside the pointer
The picture is saved under queue/audits/ and referenced from a step in 2026-09-02-capture-dim-no-loupe.json
If the dim, the pill or the timing look wrong in the picture, a task is filed for what is wrong
